Workflow.Name: DealOS | Desk drafts
Workflow.Description: A desk draft (gc_message, Draft, Pending) → gc_BuildEmailRaw → Gmail draft in the thread (new thread for a first enquiry; the thread id is saved). A draft replaced by a newer one (Discarded) is deleted from Gmail.
